verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is a platform for building AI agents (chat.agent), so consuming external MCP servers is a fair question for it. The evidence only documents Trigger.dev's own MCP server, which exposes Trigger.dev tools to AI assistants. That is the opposite role and gives no credit here. Nothing shows tasks or agents connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
